title: The Almost Perfect Guide to Event Management
summary: This introductory course welcomes anyone curious about event management, regardless of prior experience. Over four interactive days , participants will discover the core principles of organizing an event, from concept and audience definition to budgeting, logistics, marketing and on-day operations. Working in small groups, participants will choose their event type (cultural, sport, corporate or wedding) and develop a complete event plan from scratch, which they present before a jury.
